column1: # tools/symbolwatch.tsv — names known dead in a released product, each with the live replacement.
# Tab-separated. Blank lines and lines beginning '#' are ignored; every other line is five
# fields. Read by `tools/symbolcheck.py`: the gate reports any of these appearing under
# contents/, and --verify-list re-resolves every row so an entry that comes back to life fails
# loudly instead of quietly policing a name that returned.
# Before adding a row, resolve it TWO WAYS at BOTH refs. -w is not optional: git grep does not
# honour \b, so without it a longer live name lends its existence to a shorter dead one.
# product is brighter, darker or both, and it is not decoration: a symbol can be dead in one
# product and alive in the other, and the column is the only thing that tells them apart.
